method: We compared the 10 zero-ozone ENERGY STAR certified air purifiers with the highest certified smoke CADR. Smoke CADR carries most of the weight; the rest goes to the five-year electricity cost, computed from the certified yearly energy use and the current EIA U.S. average residential price. Rated room size is left out of the score because ENERGY STAR derives it from smoke CADR.
name: Best air purifiers for smoke, ranked by certified smoke CADR
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100

selection.label: Smoke CADR
selection.merge: listings with identical certified values on all 23 reported fields
